scope: Editorial exact arithmetic on retained app summaries; no model or grader execution and no stored-result modification

equal_app_pass_rate.statistic: absolute equal-app mean of trained-minus-base pass-rate differences; inclusive two-sided tail

raw_pass_count_sensitivity.statistic: absolute sum of per-app trained-minus-base passed-rubric counts; differs from equal-app pass-rate statistic

interpretation: Neither statistic establishes a trained/base difference. Equal-app rate analysis is the reported primary cluster sensitivity; pooled rubric rates113/151 vs118/151 are descriptive and not its test statistic.
